name: crosswalk
description: A walking pedestrian above three crossing stripes.
useCase: Locate a pedestrian crossing on a street map or site plan.
misuse: Use person-walking for a person or walking mode; this mark identifies a crossing.

16.reason: The complete pedestrian stays separate from three broad crossing stripes, with both arms and legs clear.

24.reason: The full walking pose and three ground stripes remain distinct within the square street marker.
